title: 第一卷 第5章 妖女第一卷 第6章 如玉
lines: 三天后的清晨。
打坐了一宿的林风眠缓缓睁开眼，只感觉神清气爽。
这三天，他没有再做那古怪的噩梦，也没有再梦见那绝色的女鬼。
这让林风眠一时之间都有些不习惯了。
至此，他确定那绝色女鬼就是从双鱼佩里面出来的！
林风眠虽然有些心疼祖传的宝物，但终究还是小命要紧。
谁知道这女鬼会不会跟妖女一样吸人精气呢？
林风眠洗漱一番，照例来到青韭峰的广场上。
他发现谢桂也在场中，看上去憔悴不少，正跟一个五大三粗的丑陋大汉说着什么。
见到林风眠到来，谢桂频频看了过来，欲言又止。
林风眠若有所思，谢桂很明显就发现了玉仙宗的不对劲。
这小子要是敢贸然行动，自己很快又要埋多一具尸体了。
思索之间，一道粉色的流光从远处飞来，飘落在场中。
那是一个衣着暴露的粉裙女子，姿容绝色，媚若天成。
轻薄的衣裙根本裹不住那火辣又有活力的身材，大片肌肤裸露在外。
清风拂来，薄纱贴身，更是凸显出那曼妙身姿，让不少男弟子都看呆了。
“柳师姐！”
众弟子纷纷弯腰行礼，一是以示尊重，二是遮掩尴尬。
来人正是玉仙宗外门的大师姐，柳媚，宗内艳名远播的美人。
柳媚媚眼如丝，看向场中众人，娇笑道：“都起来吧！”
她的声音柔媚，仿佛是情人在耳边撒娇，让不少男弟子一哆嗦，腰弯得更深了。
林风眠也喉咙微动，感觉一阵燥热，不由暗骂一声妖女。
柳媚见众人窘况，忍不住掩嘴娇笑，冲众人眨了眨眼睛。
“今天姐姐心情好，打算挑人考核，有没有人自告奋勇？”
闻言，众弟子顿时激动不已，纷纷踊跃举手。
“师姐，我可以！”
“师姐，选我啊！”
这位大师姐的通过率并不比陈清焰低多少，而且一看就得劲啊！
“大家真是热情呢！”
柳媚笑得花枝乱颤，让一众男弟子心肝也直颤，目光发直，喉咙微动。
柳媚那双桃花眼落在林风眠身上，笑盈盈道：“林师弟，可有兴趣？”
众多男弟子一脸羡慕嫉妒恨，怎么又是这小子！
content_en:
Early morning three days later.
Lin Fengmian, who had been meditating all night, slowly opened his eyes and felt refreshed.
In the past three days, he no longer had that weird nightmare, nor did he dream of that stunning female ghost.
This made Lin Fengmian feel a little uncomfortable for a while.
At this point, he was sure that the stunning female ghost came out of the Pisces pendant!
Although Lin Fengmian felt sorry for the ancestral treasure, his life still mattered after all.
Who knows if this female ghost can suck people's energy like a witch?
Lin Fengmian washed up and came to the square of Qingjiafeng as usual.
He found that Xie Gui was also present, looking quite haggard, and was talking to a tall, ugly man.
Seeing Lin Fengmian's arrival, Xie Gui looked over frequently but hesitated to speak.
Lin Fengmian was thoughtful, and Xie Gui clearly discovered something was wrong with the Jade Immortal Sect.
If this kid dares to act rashly, he will soon bury another corpse.
While he was thinking, a pink stream of light flew from a distance and fell on the field.
It was a woman in a scantily clad pink skirt, with a stunning appearance and a natural beauty.
The thin dress couldn't cover her hot and energetic figure, and a large area of ​​skin was exposed.
The breeze blows, and the tulle is close to the body, which highlights the graceful figure, leaving many male disciples stunned.
"Senior Sister Liu!"
All the disciples bent down and saluted, firstly to show respect, and secondly to cover up their embarrassment.
The person who came was none other than the senior sister of the outer sect of the Jade Immortal Sect, Liu Mei, a beauty with a well-known reputation in the sect.
Liu Mei's charming eyes were as silk as silk, she looked at everyone in the field, and said with a sweet smile: "Everyone, get up!"
Her voice was soft and charming, as if a lover was coquettishly speaking in her ears, making many male disciples shiver and bend deeper.
Lin Fengmian's throat twitched slightly, feeling hot and he couldn't help but secretly cursed a witch.
Seeing everyone's embarrassment, Liu Mei couldn't help but cover her mouth and smile, and winked at everyone.
"Sister is in a good mood today and plans to select people for assessment. Is there anyone who can volunteer?"
Hearing this, all the disciples were immediately excited and raised their hands enthusiastically.
"Sister, I can do it!"
"Sister, choose me!"
The passing rate of this senior sister is not much lower than that of Chen Qingyan, and she is very excited just by looking at it!
“Everyone is so enthusiastic!”
Liu Mei's smile made the flowers tremble, making all the male disciples' hearts tremble, their eyes straightened, and their throats twitching slightly.
Liu Mei's peach blossom eyes fell on Lin Fengmian, and she said with a smile: "Junior Brother Lin, are you interested?"
Many male disciples looked envious and jealous, why is it this kid again!
